name: Prednisone
description: A synthetic glucocorticoid prodrug converted hepatically to prednisolone, approved across a very wide range of inflammatory, allergic and autoimmune conditions. Prolonged use suppresses the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis.

systems.note: Broad anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive glucocorticoid action; the labelled indications.
Prolonged use suppresses the HPA axis; abrupt withdrawal precipitates adrenal insufficiency.
Steroid-induced hyperglycaemia is labelled and often marked.
Bone density loss, muscle catabolism and central fat redistribution are labelled.
Leukocytosis with a neutrophil shift is expected and confounds infection assessment.
Hepatic conversion is required; hepatic steatosis is reported with prolonged use.

monitors.why: Steroid-induced hyperglycaemia is labelled and often marked.
Integrated glycaemic effect of sustained glucocorticoid exposure.
HPA axis suppression; the value that governs how a taper can proceed.
Labelled muscle catabolism and central fat redistribution.
